CustomField.description: How the prompt's variables map to the template's inputs: variable=Input_Name pairs separated by semicolons, such as deal_history=Deal_History. The variable system_suffix carries the lines the caller adds after the system text (the brand's company and tone). A variable not listed is not sent.
